biography.value:
Description

A spirit which has taken the shape of a beautiful woman. The yakshi follows the orders of its master whom it formed a blood pact with, and guards locations of great importance. They are famous for how they change in strength depending on its master's primary emotion. In particular, yakshis that form pacts with those who holds a grudge or bears deep hatred often exhibit powers greater than other yakshis, but because they all look alike, it is hard to tell how strong they are, so facing them without proper preparation is an unwise decision to make.

Defense

AC 25, touch 20, flat-footed 20 (+4 deflect, +5 dex, +1 dodge, +5 natural)

hp 137 [200] (25d6+50)

mp 187

Fort +15, Ref +24, Will +21

DR 15/adamantine;

Immune critical hits, death effects, poison, sneak attacks, shadow, water;

Strong Fire;

Weakness Lightning and Holy

Offense

Speed 30 ft., swim 120 ft.

Melee Slam +12 (1d6 plus 1d8 [half shadow/water damage]) or Touch +12 (1d3 Wis damage)

Special Attacks Malediction, Mesmerizing Voice

Spells Known (FC CL 25th, Concentration +27)

At will (DC 15) - bleed, detect magic, mending, message, read magic

1st (DC 16) - dark, sleep (DC 15), water

2nd (DC 17) - dark II, silence (DC 16), water II

3rd (DC 18) - dark III, darkra, sleepga (DC 17), water III, watera

4th (DC 19) - dark IV, silencega (DC 18), water IV

5th (DC 20) - darkga, drain, drown, gloom, sleepja (DC 19), waterga

6th (DC 21) - abyss, flood, rasp, silenceja (DC 20)

7th (DC 22) - drainra, drown II, gloom II

8th (DC 23) - abyss II, doom (DC 22), flood II

Statistics

Str 10, Dex 20, Con 15, Int 20, Wis 15, Cha 18

Base Atk +12; CMB +12; CMD 27

Feats Alertness, Combat Casting, Dodge, Elemental Focus (shadow), Elemental Focus (water), Empower Spell, Extend Spell, Extra MP, Greater Spell Penetration, Silent Spell, Spell Penetration, Spell Specialization (Shadow), Spell Specialization (Water)

Skills Acrobatics +24, Bluff +24, Escape Artist +24, Knowledge (arcana) +24, Knowledge (local) +24, Knowledge (nature) +24, Perception +22, Sense Motive +22, Spellcraft +24, Stealth +24

Languages Aquan, Sylvan, Undercommon +2 others (DM's choice)

SQ Liquid Form

description.value: Once every 1d2 rounds as a standard action, The yakshi can surround a creature in a thin layer of magically viscous water. A target that fails the Reflex save (DC 27) becomes entangled and must hold its breath or risk drowning. The target or an adjacent creature can spend a full-round action on its turn scraping off the clinging fluid, allowing a new Reflex save with a +2 bonus; otherwise, the effect lasts for 1d4 minutes. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 17).

actions.name: Congeal Water

save.description: Negates entanglement and drowning risk; full-round removal grants a new save at +2

description.value: A yakshi is always in liquid form. She gains immunity to critical hits, poison, and sneak attacks. She also has DR/15 magic. She retains her own base speed, and her swim speed doubles to 120 feet.

1/day, a yakshi can release malevolence from within draining the health of all nearby enemies within a 30-ft.-radius spread. A yakshi deals 12d6 points of shadow damage and is healed by half of the total damage done unless those in the area must make a Fortitude save (DC 27) to negate the heal affect and take half damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 9th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 33).
